title: सप्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 7 · Eighteenth day: the armies gather

summary.en: After the night, Duryodhana tells the Kauravas to rise and fight, and Sanjaya describes the destruction of men, chariots and elephants in the earlier fights. Arjuna destroys the Samshaptakas and the armies prepare to fight again.
summary.kn: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕಳೆದ ನಂತರ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಕೌರವರಿಗೆ ಎದ್ದು ಹೋರಾಡಲು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಹಿಂದಿನ ಯುದ್ಧಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮನುಷ್ಯ, ರಥ, ಆನೆಗಳ ನಾಶವನ್ನು ಸಂಜಯ ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅರ್ಜುನ ಸಂಶಪ್ತಕರನ್ನು ನಾಶಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತೆ ಹೋರಾಡಲು ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.
summary.hi: रात बीतने पर दुर्योधन कौरवों से उठकर लड़ने को कहता है, और संजय पिछले युद्धों में मनुष्यों, रथों और हाथियों के नाश का वर्णन करते हैं। अर्जुन संशप्तकों का नाश करते हैं और सेनाएँ फिर लड़ने को तैयार होती हैं।
summary.te: రాత్రి గడిచాక లేచి పోరాడమని దుర్యోధనుడు కౌరవులకు చెబుతాడు; గత యుద్ధాల్లో మనుషులు, రథాలు, ఏనుగుల నాశనాన్ని సంజయుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు. అర్జునుడు సంశప్తకులను నాశనం చేస్తాడు; సేనలు మళ్లీ పోరుకు సిద్ధమవుతాయి.
summary.ta: இரவு கழிந்ததும் எழுந்து போரிடுங்கள் என்று துரியோதனன் கௌரவருக்குக் கூற, முந்தைய போர்களில் மனிதர், தேர், யானைகளின் அழிவைச் சஞ்சயன் விவரிக்கிறான். அர்ஜுனன் சம்சப்தகரை அழிக்க, படைகள் மீண்டும் போருக்கு ஆயத்தமாகின்றன.
summary.ml: രാത്രി കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം എഴുന്നേറ്റ് പൊരുതാൻ ദുര്യോധനൻ കൗരവരോട് പറയുന്നു; മുൻപത്തെ യുദ്ധങ്ങളിൽ മനുഷ്യരും രഥങ്ങളും ആനകളും നശിച്ചതിനെക്കുറിച്ച് സഞ്ജയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. അർജുനൻ സംശപ്തകരെ നശിപ്പിക്കുന്നു; സേനകൾ വീണ്ടും യുദ്ധത്തിന് ഒരുങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.7; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
व्यतीतायां रजन्यां तु राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा ।
अब्रवीत्तावकान्सर्वान्संनह्यन्तां महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: When the night had passed, King Duryodhana told all your men, "Let the great chariot-warriors arm themselves."

verses.text:
राज्ञस्तु मतमाज्ञाय समनह्यत सा चमूः ।
अयोजयन्रथांस्तूर्णं पर्यधावंस्तथापरे ॥

meaning.en: Knowing the king's wish, that army armed itself; some yoked their chariots quickly, while others ran about.

verses.text:
अकल्प्यन्त च मातङ्गाः समनह्यन्त पत्तयः ।
हयानास्तरणोपेतांश्चक्रुरन्ये सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Elephants were made ready and foot soldiers put on their armor; others by the thousand fitted horses with their trappings.

verses.text:
वादित्राणां च निनदः प्रादुरासीद्विशां पते ।
बोधनार्थं हि योधानां सैन्यानां चाप्युदीर्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: Lord of men, the sound of musical instruments rose up to wake the warriors and rouse the troops.

verses.text:
ततो बलानि सर्वाणि सेनाशिष्टानि भारत ।
संनद्धान्येव ददृशुर्मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, Bharata, all the forces that remained of the army were seen fully armed, having made death their only way back.

verses.text:
शल्यं सेनापतिं कृत्वा मद्रराजं महारथाः ।
प्रविभज्य बलं सर्वमनीकेषु व्यवस्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: The great warriors made Shalya, king of the Madras, their commander, divided the whole force, and stood arrayed in the divisions.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वे समागम्य पुत्रेण तव सैनिकाः ।
कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रौणिः शल्योऽथ सौबलः ॥

meaning.en: Then all your soldiers gathered round your son: Kripa, Kritavarman, Drona's son, Shalya, the son of Subala, and the other surviving kings made a pact.

verses.text:
अन्ये च पार्थिवाः शेषाः समयं चक्रिरे तदा ।
न न एकेन योद्धव्यं कथंचिदपि पाण्डवैः ॥

meaning.en: "None of us is ever to fight the Pandavas alone."

verses.text:
यो ह्येकः पाण्डवैर्युध्येद्यो वा युध्यन्तमुत्सृजेत् ।
स पञ्चभिर्भवेद्युक्तः पातकैः सोपपातकैः ।
अन्योन्यं परिरक्षद्भिर्योद्धव्यं सहितैश्च नः ॥

meaning.en: "Whoever fights the Pandavas alone, or abandons a comrade who is fighting, shall bear the five great sins and the minor ones as well. We must fight together, guarding one another."

verses.text:
एवं ते समयं कृत्वा सर्वे तत्र महारथाः ।
मद्रराजं पुरस्कृत्य तूर्णमभ्यद्रवन्परान् ॥

meaning.en: Having made this pact, all those great warriors put the king of Madras at their head and swiftly charged the enemy.

verses.text:
तथैव पाण्डवा राजन्व्यूह्य सैन्यं महारणे ।
अभ्ययुः कौरवान्सर्वान्योत्स्यमानाः समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: In the same way, O king, the Pandavas drew up their army in the great battle and advanced on all the Kauravas from every side, eager to fight.

verses.text:
तद्बलं भरतश्रेष्ठ क्षुब्धार्णवसमस्वनम् ।
समुद्धूतार्णवाकारमुद्धूतरथकुञ्जरम् ॥

meaning.en: That host, best of Bharatas, roared like a churned-up ocean, with chariots and elephants tossed up like the waves of a raging sea.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
द्रोणस्य भीष्मस्य च वै राधेयस्य च मे श्रुतम् ।
पातनं शंस मे भूयः शल्यस्याथ सुतस्य मे ॥

meaning.en: I have heard of the fall of Drona, Bhishma and Radha's son; now tell me again of the fall of Shalya and of my son.

verses.text:
कथं रणे हतः शल्यो धर्मराजेन संजय ।
भीमेन च महाबाहुः पुत्रो दुर्योधनो मम ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, how were Shalya and my mighty-armed son Duryodhana killed in battle, by Yudhishthira and by Bhima?

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
क्षयं मनुष्यदेहानां रथनागाश्वसंक्षयम् ।
शृणु राजन्स्थिरो भूत्वा संग्रामं शंसतो मम ॥

meaning.en: Listen steadily, O king, as I tell of that battle, the destruction of human bodies and the ruin of chariots, elephants and horses.

verses.text:
आशा बलवती राजन्पुत्राणां तेऽभवत्तदा ।
हते भीष्मे च द्रोणे च सूतपुत्रे च पातिते ।
शल्यः पार्थान्रणे सर्वान्निहनिष्यति मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Your sons had a strong hope then, my lord: that with Bhishma, Drona and the charioteer's son brought down, Shalya would slay all the Pandavas in battle.

verses.text:
तामाशां हृदये कृत्वा समाश्वास्य च भारत ।
मद्रराजं च समरे समाश्रित्य महारथम् ।
नाथवन्तमथात्मानममन्यत सुतस्तव ॥

meaning.en: Holding that hope in his heart and comforting himself, relying on the mighty king of Madras in the fight, your son felt he had a protector.

verses.text:
यदा कर्णे हते पार्थाः सिंहनादं प्रचक्रिरे ।
तदा राजन्धार्तराष्ट्रानाविवेश महद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: When Karna was killed and the Pandavas roared their lion's roar, great fear entered the sons of Dhritarashtra, O king.

verses.text:
तान्समाश्वास्य तु तदा मद्रराजः प्रतापवान् ।
व्यूह्य व्यूहं महाराज सर्वतोभद्रमृद्धिमत् ॥

meaning.en: The mighty king of Madras then consoled them and, great king, arrayed a splendid battle formation called Sarvatobhadra.

verses.text:
प्रत्युद्यातो रणे पार्थान्मद्रराजः प्रतापवान् ।
विधुन्वन्कार्मुकं चित्रं भारघ्नं वेगवत्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: The mighty king of Madras advanced against the Pandavas, shaking his bright bow, which was swifter and spared the bearer any burden.

verses.text:
रथप्रवरमास्थाय सैन्धवाश्वं महारथः ।
तस्य सीता महाराज रथस्थाशोभयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: That great warrior mounted a superb chariot yoked to Sindhu horses, and his banner, shaped like a plough, shone on the chariot, great king.

verses.text:
स तेन संवृतो वीरो रथेनामित्रकर्शनः ।
तस्थौ शूरो महाराज पुत्राणां ते भयप्रणुत् ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by that chariot, the hero, tormentor of foes, stood there, brave Shalya, dispelling the fear of your sons.

verses.text:
प्रयाणे मद्रराजोऽभून्मुखं व्यूहस्य दंशितः ।
मद्रकैः सहितो वीरैः कर्णपुत्रैश्च दुर्जयैः ॥

meaning.en: Armored, the king of Madras took the front of the formation as it advanced, together with the heroic Madrakas and the unconquerable sons of Karna.

verses.text:
सव्येऽभूत्कृतवर्मा च त्रिगर्तैः परिवारितः ।
गौतमो दक्षिणे पार्श्वे शकैश्च यवनैः सह ॥

meaning.en: On the left stood Kritavarman, surrounded by the Trigartas, and on the right flank Kripa the Gautama, with the Shakas and Yavanas.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा पृष्ठतोऽभूत्काम्बोजैः परिवारितः ।
दुर्योधनोऽभवन्मध्ये रक्षितः कुरुपुंगवैः ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthama stood at the rear, surrounded by the Kambojas, and Duryodhana was in the middle, guarded by the best of the Kurus.

verses.text:
हयानीकेन महता सौबलश्चापि संवृतः ।
प्रययौ सर्वसैन्येन कैतव्यश्च महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Subala's son Shakuni, surrounded by a great force of cavalry, also advanced with the whole army, and so did the great warrior Kaitavya.

verses.text:
पाण्डवाश्च महेष्वासा व्यूह्य सैन्यमरिंदमाः ।
त्रिधा भूत्वा महाराज तव सैन्यमुपाद्रवन् ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas, mighty archers and tamers of foes, drew up their army, and divided into three, O great king, they rushed upon your army.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च सात्यकिश्च महारथः ।
शल्यस्य वाहिनीं तूर्णमभिदुद्रुवुराहवे ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna, Shikhandi and the great warrior Satyaki swiftly charged Shalya's division in the fight.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा स्वेनानीकेन संवृतः ।
शल्यमेवाभिदुद्राव जिघांसुर्भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, surrounded by his own army, rushed at Shalya alone, eager to kill him, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
हार्दिक्यं तु महेष्वासमर्जुनः शत्रुपूगहा ।
संशप्तकगणांश्चैव वेगतोऽभिविदुद्रुवे ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna, slayer of masses of enemies, swiftly charged the great archer, Kritavarman, and the bands of Samshaptakas.

verses.text:
गौतमं भीमसेनो वै सोमकाश्च महारथाः ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त राजेन्द्र जिघांसन्तः परान्युधि ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena and the Somakas, great warriors, rushed at Kripa the Gautama, wishing to kill the enemy in battle, O king of kings.

verses.text:
माद्रीपुत्रौ तु शकुनिमुलूकं च महारथौ ।
ससैन्यौ सहसेनौ तावुपतस्थतुराहवे ॥

meaning.en: The two sons of Madri, both great warriors, with their armies and troops, confronted Shakuni and Ulupa's son Uluka in the fight.

verses.text:
तथैवायुतशो योधास्तावकाः पाण्डवान्रणे ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धा विविधायुधपाणयः ॥

meaning.en: In the same way, tens of thousands of your warriors, furious and holding many kinds of weapons, charged the Pandavas in battle.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
हते भीष्मे महेष्वासे द्रोणे कर्णे महारथे ।
कुरुष्वल्पावशिष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु च संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: With Bhishma, the great archer, and Drona and the great warrior Karna dead, and only a few Pandavas left in the fight,

verses.text:
सुसंरब्धेषु पार्थेषु पराक्रान्तेषु संजय ।
मामकानां परेषां च किं शिष्टमभवद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, when the Pandavas were enraged and valiant, what strength remained of my side and of the enemy?

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
यथा वयं परे राजन्युद्धाय समवस्थिताः ।
यावच्चासीद्बलं शिष्टं संग्रामे तन्निबोध मे ॥

meaning.en: Hear from me, O king, how we and the enemy stood ready for battle, and how much force was left in the war.

verses.text:
एकादश सहस्राणि रथानां भरतर्षभ ।
दश दन्तिसहस्राणि सप्त चैव शतानि च ॥

meaning.en: Best of Bharatas, your side had eleven thousand chariots and ten thousand seven hundred elephants,

verses.text:
पूर्णे शतसहस्रे द्वे हयानां भरतर्षभ ।
नरकोट्यस्तथा तिस्रो बलमेतत्तवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: two hundred thousand horses in full, and three crores of foot soldiers; this was your strength.

verses.text:
रथानां षट्सहस्राणि षट्सहस्राश्च कुञ्जराः ।
दश चाश्वसहस्राणि पत्तिकोटी च भारत ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas' strength left in the battle was six thousand chariots, six thousand elephants, ten thousand horses, and one crore of foot soldiers, Bharata.

verses.text:
एतद्बलं पाण्डवानामभवच्छेषमाहवे ।
एत एव समाजग्मुर्युद्धाय भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Only these forces were left, best of Bharatas, and only these came together to fight.

verses.text:
एवं विभज्य राजेन्द्र मद्रराजमते स्थिताः ।
पाण्डवान्प्रत्युदीयाम जयगृद्धाः प्रमन्यवः ॥

meaning.en: Having divided up in this way, O king, we stood by the counsel of the king of Madras, eager for victory and furious, and advanced against the Pandavas.

verses.text:
तथैव पाण्डवाः शूराः समरे जितकाशिनः ।
उपयाता नरव्याघ्राः पाञ्चालाश्च यशस्विनः ॥

meaning.en: In the same way the brave Pandavas, winners of battles, came on, together with the glorious Panchalas, those tigers among men.

verses.text:
एवमेते बलौघेन परस्परवधैषिणः ।
उपयाता नरव्याघ्राः पूर्वां संध्यां प्रति प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Thus those tigers among men, each wishing to kill the other, came on with their floods of troops, my lord, at the first twilight.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं घोररूपं भयानकम् ।
तावकानां परेषां च निघ्नतामितरेतरम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the battle began, terrible and fearsome, as your men and the enemy struck one another.
